title: AnthracoForm: Offline single-file tool for anthracological determination and analysis
description:
AnthracoForm is a single-file, offline HTML application for recording, managing and analysing wood-charcoal (anthracological) data fragment by fragment: IAWA anatomical features, taphonomy, saturation curves per stratigraphic unit, and an R-ready CSV format documented in docs/ (data dictionary, CSV template, R examples, user guide).

Regional modules, same code: AnthracoForm – Saharo-Sindian (Sindh) and AnthracoForm – Eastern Mediterranean (Lebanon, pre-release). Module names follow floristic regions (Loidi & Vynokurov 2024); the place in brackets is where the reference collection was made. Until v1.2 the modules were called Sindh and Lebanon.

Changes in each release: see the CHANGELOG in each module folder.
